title: WOS Studio (Authoring) — API Common $defs Library
description: Shared wire-shape $defs for the Studio REST API surface per studio/specs/api-ingestion.md (and future per-surface specs api-review.md, api-projection.md, api-approval.md). Registered by $id only; consumed by other api/* schemas via $ref. RFC 9457 ProblemDetails with Studio extensions, RFC 3339 timestamps, cursor pagination, idempotency-key shape.
$comment: Promotion status (Stage-8 deliverable 15, 2026-05-08): MVP shape; field shapes match the api-ingestion endpoint table.

ProblemDetails.description: RFC 9457 problem-details object with Studio extensions. Returned for every non-2xx response per SA-MUST-api-ingest-062.

type.description: URI identifying the problem type. Per RFC 9457.

traceId.description: Studio extension: server-side trace id for incident correlation.

violations.description: Studio extension: structured rule-violation list, one per failing schema/lint check.

pointer.description: JSON Pointer to the failing field, when applicable.

CursorPage.description: Cursor pagination envelope for list endpoints. `nextCursor` is opaque; clients pass it back unchanged on the next call.

IdempotencyKey.description: Client-supplied idempotency key per SA-MUST-api-ingest-061. Required on POST endpoints; the server stores the (idempotencyKey, request-hash) tuple and returns the prior response on replay.

CorrelationId.description: Server-issued correlation id pairing API submission with the AuthoringProvenanceRecord(s) emitted during async processing. Per SA-MUST-api-ingest-011.

EtagToken.description: Strong ETag per RFC 9110. The ingestion API uses ingestedHash-derived ETags for SourceVersion raw bytes (SA-MUST-api-ingest-005).

RFC3339Timestamp.description: RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC (Z suffix). Per SA-MUST-api-ingest-063.
